title: Tiny, cute anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ropeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9a45c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8803c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='metalGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fb6cc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6f8aa3'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stockGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8aa6bf'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6b85a0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ring at the top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#c0d4e6' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3' fill='#7f97ae'/>

  <!-- rope wrapped around the stock -->
  <path d='M40 22 Q50 30 60 22' fill='none' stroke='url(#ropeGrad)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 22 Q50 28 58 22' fill='none' stroke='#e3c48c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='52' rx='3.5' fill='url(#metalGrad)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='2' height='44' rx='1' fill='#cddfee'/>

  <!-- stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x='28' y='24' width='44' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='url(#stockGrad)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='26' width='36' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#bcd0e2'/>

  <!-- crown (the bottom point) -->
  <path d='M40 72 Q50 92 60 72 Z' fill='#8aa6bf'/>

  <!-- left fluke -->
  <path d='M44 78 C36 74 26 70 22 62 C30 66 36 66 40 70 C42 73 44 76 44 78 Z' fill='url(#metalGrad)'/>
  <path d='M42 76 C35 72 28 69 25 64' fill='none' stroke='#b9cee0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- right fluke -->
  <path d='M56 78 C64 74 74 70 78 62 C70 66 64 66 60 70 C58 73 56 76 56 78 Z' fill='url(#metalGrad)'/>
  <path d='M58 76 C65 72 72 69 75 64' fill='none' stroke='#b9cee0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cute face on the shank -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#3f5870'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#3f5870'/>
  <circle cx='46.7' cy='45.2' r='0.8' fill='#eaf4fd'/>
  <circle cx='54.7' cy='45.2' r='0.8' fill='#eaf4fd'/>
  <path d='M46 52 Q50 56 54 52' fill='none' stroke='#3f5870' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#f2a6b8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#f2a6b8' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
